problem_type: Persistent user menu customization must share a validated settings boundary
symptom: Canvas add menus discard user hiding and ordering because only a fixed table exists; new IPC requires a safety contract. First real Electron run reproduced right-click on menu items being captured as canvas pan before their contextmenu handler.
direct_cause: No persisted menu preference exists between the fixed intent table and all menu projections.
class_root: Menu preferences lack a shared normalization and trusted persistence owner.
affected_population: All users customizing the resident rail or full/overflow add menus
entry_points: Overflow menu hides/orders items; resident rail derives the same preference
internal_only_reason: This is an internal settings contract following the existing vendorPreference boundary, not an external format.
invariants: All settings IPC calls validate the sender before read/write.
Both settings reads and writes normalize identifiers; default intent definitions stay unchanged.
All menus project the same preference, and resetting restores every default intent.
generality_proof: Read, write and renderer projections all normalize via the same schema; ordering and hiding never mutate the node registry or default table.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Normalize schemaVersion 1 preferences on both sides of IPC.
Reject untrusted senders before settings access.
Shared menu ownership guard; canvas pan capture must defer menu gestures.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Both handlers assertTrustedSender before accessing injected storage.
Both consume useCanvasMenuPreferenceStore and project the same default table.
Checks existing isCanvasMenuTarget before acquiring right-button pan; real walk failed before this guard and must pass after.

recurrence.reason: Every reload and every menu consumer must preserve the same preference.
same_class_scan: rg vendorPreference electron/settings electron/preload.ts src/desktop/settingsBridge.ts: confirmed trusted sender and atomic JSON conventions.
rg canvasFullAddSections canvasMoreAddSections canvasResidentAddIntents src: found all projections in CanvasToolbar.tsx.

prevention.invariant: Normalize both identifier lists before persistence and projection.
prevention.failure_mode: Malformed list entries are discarded and untrusted IPC callers throw before storage.
prevention.strategy: One shared schema and one trusted settings namespace for every consumer.

legacy_paths.rationale: New capability; original intent table remains the default source, not a second persistence implementation.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Uses existing trusted settings bridge and atomic writer; no new dependency.

migration: Missing preference files normalize to empty hidden/order lists; existing menu defaults are unchanged.
residual_risks: Disk failure remains possible; renderer reports failed saves and rolls back the latest optimistic preference.
